description: Least-privilege shell: the main window only, plus the world contract (with sitting in a session from the side panel, leaving the seated view, and the seated session's terminal stream and input), the agent registry's snapshot, opencodex statistics, Of the month and token statistics, starting a new background session in a project (New session), the native message dialog for the quit prompt, and opening http and https links (only) in the default browser from the seated terminal.
